Maya (Docs): PR 421 is up - draft language for SOC2 audit logs & retention. Need legal + security signoff before we merge the SDK snippets. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/421 :eyes:
Tom (Security): I'll review wording around 'tenant-scoped' vs 'per-customer' retention. Can we avoid 'tenant' in customer-facing docs? :thinking_face:
Eli (Legal): prefer 'customer instance' over 'tenant' for external docs. Also need a line about retention exceptions for legal hold. I can suggest phrasing.
Sophia (Eng): added a TypeScript SDK snippet for export -> shows how to call /v1/audit/exports with retention ttl param. snippet:
```ts
const resp = await client.auditExports.create({range: '30d', redact: true})
console.log(resp.url)
```
Kyle (DevEx): Also added a cURL + Python example. cURL uses header `X-Redwood-Export-Format: jsonl` — is that ok?
Tom (Security): remove header name leakage; use `Accept` or `Content-Type` instead. Also add guidance: do not include unredacted PII unless customer enabled legal-hold export via Support.
Eli (Legal): Suggested wording: 'Exports redact personal data by default. Customers can request unredacted exports for legal holds; support must approve and record justification.'
Maya (Docs): Nice. Two outstanding asks: 1) Sophia pls change snippet to use `retention_ttl` param name we use in API. 2) Eli pls add exact sentence for legal hold log in bullet list. I'll hold PR until both comments are resolved.
Sophia (Eng): updated snippet and pushed commit 7f3a2f. New snippet:
```ts
await client.audit.export({retention_ttl: '90d', redact: true})
```
Eli (Legal): LGTM. Also recommend adding a short note under 'Retention' about default TTL: 'default 90 days for hosted, enterprise can configure via Dedicated/Private.'
Maya (Docs): added that note and a small migration note for SDK v2 -> v3 param rename. @DocsBot can you add changelog entry?
DocsBot: Changelog entry created: docs: clarify audit export retention wording and SDK param rename (PR 421) :white_check_mark:
Tom (Security): final check: please add a short QA checklist for reviewers: 1) confirm redaction examples shown, 2) legal hold process linked, 3) SDK param names match runtime. Thx
Maya (Docs): done. Planning to merge tomorrow morning after one more pass. Thanks everyone :bow:
